errors.text_span: 此饼图显示了一个关于单音形容词定语分布和“的”字隐现的分析，其中包含三个切片，总共有三个类别。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate pie charts, not a single one. The two charts have a total of four slices (two in each), not three.

The yellow slice, representing 96.71%, is labeled ““的”字只现不隐” ('de' only appears, not hidden). The machine description incorrectly states ““的”字只隐现” ('de' is only hidden), which is the opposite meaning and corresponds to the green slice.
The value 96.71% represents a percentage or proportion of the total, not a '时长' (duration).

errors.text_span: 两个较小的切片是橙色
errors.evidence: There is only one orange slice (26.07%). The other slice mentioned, with 73.93%, is blue. The description fails to identify the blue and green slices.

errors.text_span: 第一个标记为“的”字只隐现+单音名词或者同音词
errors.evidence: The label for the 73.93% slice is “双音形容词+单音名词” (Disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun). The generated description invents a completely incorrect label.

errors.text_span: 第二个标记为“单音形容词平音名词”
errors.evidence: The label for the 26.07% slice is “单音形容词+单音名词” (Monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun). The machine description misreads '单音' (monosyllabic) as '平音'.

errors.text_span: 并且“的”字缩短的切片被视觉上偏移。
errors.evidence: No slice is visually offset or exploded from its pie chart. The description invents this visual feature.
The description omits the overall title of the figure, “组合式‘a的n’结构” (Combined 'a de n' structure), which is essential context.
The description completely omits the green slice, which is labeled ““的”字只隐不现” and accounts for 3.29% of the right-hand pie chart.
